meta.title: teeTIM // natural fiber ... artificial design
meta.desc: Homepage of the clothing designer 100% made in Quebec, designed by TIM students using designs created by artificial intelligence, and made with 100% natural and organic fibers.

home.leadH1: T-Shirts, hoodies, and caps made in Quebec 💯
home.leadH4: /** with a little help from DALL-E 😉 **/
home.para1: Today, the T-shirt is an essential piece of clothing in everyone's wardrobe. And at a time when environmental issues are more important than ever, we prefer T-shirts made in Quebec to reduce environmental impact and promote local craftsmanship.
home.para2: V-neck, crew neck, loose or fitted, short-sleeved or long-sleeved for those who get chilly, plain or patterned to add style to an outfit... The T-shirt is available in a variety of colors, styles, and patterns.
